channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Kalonzo Musyoka oo sheegay inuu taageeri doono musharaxa mideysan ee mucaaradka Kenya ee doorashada 2027
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper, Kalonzo Musyoka, ayaa Sabtidii ku dhawaaqay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu ka tanaasulo hammigiisa madaxweynenimo si uu u taageero musharax keliya oo mucaaradku u soo bandhigo doorashada guud ee Kenya ee 2027, sida ay wariyeen Capital FM iyo KBC.

item.title: Rugby: Wales oo 35-28 kaga adkaatay New Zealand, guushii ugu horreysay tan iyo 1953
item.description: Xulka rugby-ga Wales ayaa Sabtidii magaalada Cardiff 35-28 kaga adkaaday New Zealand tartanka Nations Championship, taas oo ahayd guushoodii ugu horreysay ee ay ka gaaraan All Blacks muddo 73 sano ah.

item.title: Talyaaniga oo Meta ku ganaaxay 805 milyan oo yuuro, kadib markii ay sawirrada isticmaaleyaasha gashay oggolaansho la'aan
item.description: Hay'adda ilaalinta xogta ee Talyaaniga ayaa Sabtidii shirkadda Meta, oo leh Facebook, ku ganaaxday 805 milyan oo yuuro, iyadoo ku eedeysay inay app-ka Facebook ee Android ku gashay sawirrada iyo muuqaallada isticmaaleyaasha iyadoo aan helin oggolaanshahooda gaarka ah.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo Antalya ku kala saxiixday heshiis lagu xoojinayo ilaalinta qoysaska iyo adeegyada bulshada
item.description: Wasiirka Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Soomaaliya, Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, iyo dhiggeeda Turkiga, Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş, ayaa magaalada Antalya ku kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad oo ku saabsan adeegyada bulshada iyo ilaalinta qoysaska, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Mohamed Salah oo noqday gooldhaliyaha ugu badan taariikhda xulka Masar
item.description: Xiddigii hore ee Liverpool, Mohamed Salah, ayaa noqday ciyaaryahanka goolasha ugu badan u dhaliyay xulka Masar, kadib markii uu laba gool u dhaliyay guushii 5-0 ee Malawi ee isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika, sida uu sheegay Liverpool FC.

item.title: Bulgaria oo joojisay hubka ay Ukraine uga bixin jirtay kaydka ciidankeeda
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Bulgaria, Rumen Radev, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu aanu Ukraine siin doonin hub iyo rasaas laga soo qaado kaydka ciidanka, aanuna ka qayb qaadan doonin maalgelin cusub oo Midowga Yurub, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo keligiis ku sugnaa hoolka shirkii Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka – Kuraastii loo diyaariyey ka qaybgalayaasha oo bannaan
item.description: Sawir laga soo qaaday goobta loo diyaariyey shirka Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka ayaa muujinaya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo keligiis fadhiya miiska dhexe ee shirka, iyadoo kuraastii kale ee hoolka ay bannaan yihiin.

item.title: Kenya: qiimaha shidaalka oo aan isbeddelin bisha soo socota, EPRA ayaa sheegtay
item.description: Hay'adda Nidaamisa Tamarta iyo Batroolka ee Kenya (EPRA) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in qiimaha batroolka, diiseelka iyo gaaska aysan isbeddelin muddada 14 November ilaa 15 December, iyadoo dowladdu ay kabid ku bixisay, sida ay werisay The Standard.

item.title: Baraawe oo warshad ogsijiinta caafimaadka soo saarta laga hirgeliyay Isbitaalka Guud
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, xarigga ka jaray warshad cusub oo soo saarta ogsijiinta caafimaadka oo laga dhisay Isbitaalka Guud ee degmada Baraawe, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya oo Muqdisho ku bilaabay wada-tashigii ugu horreeyay ee wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda
item.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Hindiya ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, magaalada Muqdisho ka bilaabay wada-tashigii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah ee u dhexeeya wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda ee labada dal, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan iyo Suudaan oo Khartoum ku saxiixday heshiis ku saabsan mugga saliidda ceeriin
item.description: Koonfur Suudaan iyo Suudaan ayaa magaalada Khartoum ku saxiixay heshiis is-afgarad (MoU) oo lagu waafajinayo mugga saliidda ceeriin ee labada dal, laguna xoojinayo iskaashiga qaybta batroolka, sida ay werisay Eye Radio Sabtida 14 November.

item.title: Zelensky: Mareykanka ayaa soo jeediyay in Ukraine ka baxdo Donbas si ay u hesho xubinnimada NATO
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa sheegay in wada-xaajoodayaasha Mareykanka ay soo jeediyeen fikrad ah in Ukraine ciidamadeeda kala baxdo qaybta Donbas ee ay weli gacanta ku hayso, beddelkeedana ay ku biirto NATO, sida ay werisay BBC iyo warbaahin kale Sabtida 14 November.

item.title: Erdoğan oo Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay wada-hadal siyaasadeed iyo midnimo qaran
item.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud kula hadlay muhiimadda midnimada qaranka iyo wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo lagu xalliyo khilaafka Soomaaliya, sida uu sheegay war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Turkiga oo ay soo xigatay Hiiraan Online Sabtida 14 November.

item.title: Axmed Madoobe oo Mukhtaar Sheekh Axmed Cabdulle u magacaabay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Jubaland
item.description: Madaxweynaha Jubaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa Sabtida 14 November wareegto ka soo saaray magaalada Kismaayo, kuna magacaabay Mukhtaar Sheekh Axmed Cabdulle inuu noqdo Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Jubaland, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Golaha Ammaanka QM oo howlgalka nabad-ilaalinta Abyei u kordhiyay ilaa November 2027
item.description: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Jimcihii 13 November sannad kale u kordhiyay howlgalka ciidamada nabad-ilaalinta ee Abyei (UNISFA), ilaa 15 November 2027, iyadoo Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ay ka aamuseen codbixinta, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo doorashada guud dib ugu dhigay 11 February 2027
item.description: Guddiga Qaranka ee Doorashooyinka Koonfur Suudaan (NEC) ayaa doorashooyinka guud ee dalka dib ugu dhigay 11 February 2027, halkii ay ka ahaayeen 22 December 2026, sida uu muujinayo jadwal cusub oo ay heshay Radio Tamazuj, oo ay sidoo kale werisay Eye Radio.

item.title: Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya: Gogosha Wadatashiga Qaran ayaa dhawaan la furayaa
item.description: Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Sabtida 14 November sheegtay in ay socdaan xiriirro lala leeyahay dhinacyada lagu casuumay Gogosha Wadatashiga Qaran, taas oo ay sheegtay in dhawaan la furi doono, sida ay werisay warbaahinta dowladda ee Radio Muqdisho.

item.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka jawaabtay cambaareynta khubarada QM ee xil-ka-qaadista Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare
item.description: Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Sabtida 14 November jawaab rasmi ah ka bixisay bayaan ay khubaro Qaramada Midoobay 12 November ku cambaareeyeen xil-ka-qaadista Guddoomiyihii Maxkamadda Sare, iyadoo sheegtay inay ka go'an tahay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida garsoorka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Rugby: Faransiiska oo 21-19 kaga adkaaday Koonfur Afrika garoonka Stade de France
item.description: Xulka rugby-ga Faransiiska ayaa Jimcihii 13 November garoonka Stade de France ee Paris 21-19 kaga adkaaday Koonfur Afrika, oo labadii koob ee adduunka ee ugu dambeeyay ku guulaysatay, kulan ka tirsan wareegga 5aad ee Nations Championship.

item.title: Kenya: Lixda gobol ee xeebta oo loogu baaqay inay xoojiyaan u diyaargarowga tsunami
item.description: Xarunta Hawlgallada Masiibooyinka Qaranka ee Kenya (NDOC) ayaa ugu baaqday lixda gobol ee xeebta dalka inay tababarro joogto ah oo tsunami ah ka sameeyaan dugsiyada, goobaha dalxiiska iyo bulshada kalluumeysatada, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.

item.title: Shirka dalalka ku hadla Faransiiska oo Cambodia ka furmay iyadoo khilaafka Rwanda iyo Congo uu hareeyay
item.description: Shirka labadii sannadoodba mar ee Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Francophonie ayaa Sabtida ka bilaabmay magaalada Phnom Penh ee Cambodia, iyadoo doorashada xoghayaha guud ee ururka ay khilaaf ka dhex abuurtay Rwanda iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Jarmalka oo hay'adaha sirdoonka siiyay awoodo cusub oo ballaaran
item.description: Baarlamaanka Jarmalka (Bundestag) ayaa Jimcihii ansixiyay sharci siinaya hay'adaha sirdoonka dalka awood ay ku jebiyaan ama ku carqaladeeyaan khataraha cadawga, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera, iyadoo codbixintu ahayd 308 haa, 190 maya iyo 71 ka aamusay.

item.title: Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar oo soo gabagabowday, Shiinaha oo dahab ugu badan qaatay
item.description: Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026 ayaa Jimcihii ku soo gabagabowday caasimadda Senegal kadib laba toddobaad, iyadoo Shiinaha uu qaatay biladaha dahabka ugu badan, dalalka Afrikana ay heleen tiradii biladaha ugu badnayd abid, sida ay werisay DW.

item.title: Wada-hadalkii Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka ee Sabtida oo dib u dhacay
item.description: Wada-hadal la filayay inay maanta, Sabti 14 November, Muqdisho ku yeeshaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kooxaha mucaaradka ayaa dib u dhacay, kadib markii Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo Nabad & Nolol ay sheegeen inaysan ka qayb geli doonin wada-hadal aan lahayn dammaanad-qaad iyo dhexdhexaadin caalami ah, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Duulimaadyada Mareykanka oo dib u bilaabmay kadib markii la qaaday hakadkii dalka oo dhan
item.description: Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) ayaa habeenimadii Jimcaha qaadday hakadkii saacadaha socday ee garoomada dalka oo dhan, iyadoo masuuliyiintu sheegeen in cilladda aysan sababin weerar internet, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: SpaceX oo Starship u dirtay meeraha dhulka, balse gantaalka hoose ayaa ku qarxay Gacanka Mexico
item.description: Shirkadda SpaceX ayaa si guul leh u dirtay duulimaadkii ugu dambeeyay ee dayax-gacmeedka Starship, balse kama ay soo celin gantaalka hoose ee Super Heavy sidii loo qorsheeyay, kaas oo ku qarxay Gacanka Mexico, sida ay werisay DW.

item.title: Mareykanka oo waayay magacii dal ka xorobay jadeecada kadib 26 sano
item.description: Guddi khubaro madax-bannaan oo warbixin u gudbiya agaasimaha Ururka Caafimaadka Pan-Ameerika (PAHO) ayaa toddobaadkan go'aamiyay in jadeecada aan mar dambe loo arkin cudur Mareykanka ka xorobay, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Svitolina oo kaga adkaatay Sabalenka, kuna gudubtay semi-finalka WTA Finals
item.description: Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine ayaa 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 kaga adkaatay Aryna Sabalenka tartanka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells, taasoo soo afjartay xilli-ciyaareedka Sabalenka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Aqalka Cad: Trump, Xi iyo Putin ayaa Khamiista Shenzhen ku yeelan doona kulan saddex-geesood ah oo nukliyeer ah
item.description: Aqalka Cad ee Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii shaaciyay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu toddobaadka soo socda magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha kula kulmi doono hoggaamiyaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah ee hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Goolhayaha Andorra Jesús Owono oo 12 kulan laga ganaaxay isku dhacii ku dambeeyay geerida Jesús de Miguel
item.description: Guddiga anshaxa ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Isbaanya (RFEF) ayaa Jimcihii 12 kulan ka ganaaxay goolhayaha FC Andorra Jesús Owono, kadib isku dhac uu la galay weeraryahankii Tenerife Jesús de Miguel, kaas oo maalin kadib geeriyooday, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
